messages:
anya: quick sync — follow-up to the demote/evict RFC rollout that hit errors in staging this morning. want to capture the incident, short-term fix, and next steps.
kevin: morning. saw 5xx spikes in the canary dashboard. do we know root cause?
anya: summary: fast-replicate path + async eviction + demote shortcut could leave a prefix flagged HOT on node A while node B's residency view was stale. reads routed to B returned errors during the window.
maria: so mismatched visibility across shard replicas. is this the same as the tombstone-delivery gap we flagged earlier?
anya: related but different. tombstones did propagate, but our optimistic demote didn't force local materialization before allowing reads to be redirected. timing exposed a race.
tle: is full lease semantics the only safe option? leases are heavy.
josh: we discussed a couple of lighter-weight mitigations in the incident room: 1) publish a per-prefix demote-ack event that readers can observe, 2) bump a demote generation/version so old residency tokens fail fast, 3) synchronous local tombstone materialization for the demote path.
kevin: tradeoffs? sync materialization adds tail latency on demote ops but is simpler and very local. version bump is cheap but requires readers to validate. demote-ack needs cross-node ACKs and adds complexity.
anya: agreed. for immediate fix we rolled back the shortcut and will implement a hybrid: local tombstone materialize + version bump on demote. that prevents the stale-token routing without global ack.
maria: telemetry requests: count of version-mismatch fallbacks, demote duration P50/P95, and routing fallback rate. add alert if mismatch-fallback > 0.05% over 5m.
tle: can we simulate the race deterministically in our test harness? i can add a chaos test that injects delayed replication and concurrent demote+reads.
josh: please also add a smoke test in the routing layer: when a reader sees a token/version mismatch, it must immediately switch to read-through and record a metric; it must never return 5xx.
kevin: one more long-term idea: two-phase demote with fast-path markers. phase 1: mark-local + publish marker; phase 2: final demote after either timeout or observed N replicas with marker. that avoids full cross-node lease but gives better correctness guarantees.
anya: +1. tle, can you sketch two-phase demote for next week's architecture sync? include failure modes (marker loss, slow replicas, partition).
tle: on it. i'll include options for timeouts, quorum, and progressive backoff.
maria: operational note: add a dashboard tile for demote-induced fallbacks and a runbook step to throttle demote traffic in case of storm.
anya: owners: i'll do the tombstone materialize + version bump PR (aiming today EOD), maria will own telemetry + alerts, tle will draft the two-phase demote RFC, josh will add tests to the chaos harness.
kevin: thumbs. please keep the short fix minimal and reversible. add a feature flag.
anya: yes feature-flagged and opt-in in staging. infra-bot: rolled back the simplify rollout in staging at 08:47 UTC (deploy rwd-stg-evict-047).
infra-bot: note: canary alert created for evict-5xx-spike; paging threshold set to 0.5% over 1m.
anya: snippet of the cheap version-bump reader logic: 
```
// demote path:
prefix.gen += 1
materialize_local_tombstones(prefix)
// readers:
if request.token.gen != current_prefix.gen {
  metrics.increment("prefetch.token_mismatch")
  // fallback to read-through (no 5xx)
  return read_through(prefix)
}
```
kevin: simple and understandable. let's avoid silent retries; we want clear telemetry.
josh: i'll add a deterministic harness case that stalls replication and races demote+read, assert no 5xx and assert fallback metric incremented once.
maria: also ensure we surface the mismatch as an event in tracing so customers can debug if they hit it in prod.
tle: noted. pushing design doc next week.
anya: will post PR link when ready. thanks everyone.
